children: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) posted blowout fiscal Q2 AI-driven revenue and margins while warning memory shortages, disclosing massive AI infrastructure financing ($105B+), shipping Vera CPUs/Vera Rubin racks, raising server prices, eyeing big acquisitions and fueling a volatile, rallying market reaction.
Previous Week Recap
NVIDIA Revenue Surges, Outlook
: NVIDIA (NVDA) reported fiscal Q2 revenue surge, strong Data Center sales, high gross margin and net income; guided Q3 revenue and margin, flagged memory cost pressure, and noted AWS GPU deployment.
AI Infrastructure Financing Commitments
: NVIDIA disclosed large financing and guarantee commitments tied to AI infrastructure: at least $105B for an OpenAI Ohio data-center, $125B in program guarantees, and $36B in cloud sales guarantees.
Vera CPUs, Rack Systems Shipments
: NVIDIA shipped Vera CPUs and Vera Rubin NVL72 rack systems to partners including SpaceX and AWS. Vera: 88 Olympus cores, LPDDR5X ~1.2 TB/s, claims up to 1.8× faster vs x86 for AI tasks.
NVIDIA Nears Hugging Face Buyout
: NVIDIA (NVDA) is reportedly in advanced talks to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9–$13+ billion; earlier NVDA offered ~$500M valuing it near $7B. Traders: deal price range and timing.
Memory Shortages Pin Production
: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) warned that shortages of memory components will constrain the pace at which it can scale production and expand output, despite providing upbeat revenue guidance.
NVDA Premarket Rise, Leveraged ETFs
: NVDA jumped in premarket after earnings. Leveraged 2x NVDA ETFs rallied about 13–14%. GraniteShares 2x NVDA ETF holds roughly $3.9B and targets twice NVDA’s daily return.
Server Price Increases For AI Chips
: NVIDIA told major customers it will raise server prices for AI chips, including Vera Rubin and Blackwell, by over 15% in many cases, hitting NVDA-related semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks
Perplexity Funding Round Talks
: NVDA is reportedly negotiating to join a Perplexity funding round valuing the AI startup above $30B. NVDA already holds a stake and Perplexity uses NVIDIA Vera CPUs for AI agents.
NVDA-Linked Rack AI Growth
: TrendForce forecasts NVDA-linked rack AI systems (NVL72, GB300, VR200, VR300) to surge in 2027: NVL72 shipments +50%+ YoY; combined GB300/VR200/VR300 output value up 214% to ~$710B.
Michael Burry NVDA Bets
: Michael Burry holds mixed NVDA bets: boosted puts (≈3.5%–4% of portfolio) ahead of fiscal Q2 and bought December calls in the mid‑to‑high $200s as hedge; cites lower intrinsic value.
